message: `v-hint` applies a directive to <Item>, a component, which has no element of its own there: a directive's hooks run on the element it is written on.
help: Apply the directive to an element inside it.

message: `v-hint`'s value is an object literal built in place: it is a new value at every render on React and Vue, which runs `updated` each time, and the same one on Svelte, which never does.
help: Pass a value that changes only when it should: a state, a derived value (`computed(() => ({ … }))`), a prop, a setup function or a primitive.

message: `v-hint` is written without a value: a directive's hooks receive one.
help: Write `v-hint={value}`, or `v-hint={true}` for a directive that needs none.
